fact: Manzini Municipal Council issued 2024/2025 rates bills to individual ratepayers (by post, email and bulk SMS of the payable amount), keeps ratepayer contact and ownership details, and lets ratepayers check rates balances and pay on USSD *440#; payments carry the plot or account number.
Only the Municipal Council of Manzini is described; the post gives no count of other Eswatini local governments.
The council says it has introduced a USSD code (*440#) for checking rates balances and paying, alongside bulk SMS delivery of bill amounts, for the 2024/2025 billing year.

Manzini Municipal Council says rates were billed in April 2020 and that some property owners had not paid since, which it tracks by account and plot number; in December 2020 it added the Eswatini Mobile e-Mali wallet to MTN Mobile Money, EFT, debit order, card and cash at the Rates Hall.
Only the Municipal Council of Manzini is described; no count of other Eswatini local governments is given.
In December 2020 Manzini activated e-Mali as a new rates payment channel, with an airtime promotion for payments of E500 or more through 31 December 2020.
